title: HF660 (2023-2024 Regular): Age of eligibility established to apply for permit to carry a pistol at 18 years of age.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2023-01-20; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/93/2023/0/HF/660/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced version, 2023-01-20 (as filed). The bill strikes the age '21' and inserts '18'.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 2): (b) Unless a sheriff denies a permit under the exception set forth in subdivision 6, paragraph (a), clause (3), a sheriff must issue a permit to an applicant if the person:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 2): (2) is at least 18 years old and a citizen or a permanent resident of the United States;
